Every brass instrument produces its soun.why: The definition of the family, stated in every music reference and in the lead of the Wikipedia article, which defines the family by how the sound is made rather than by the metal. Lip buzzing is named with the family often in Dolma. No exceptions: metal instruments with reeds (the saxophone, the sarrusophone) are woodwinds, and lip-vibrated instruments not made of brass (the cornett, the serpent) are classed with the brass.
